settings.property_package: idaes_representability.build_property_package (SYN-001, Ideal EoS, SmoothVLE, h_form_ig = L_i, h_form_liq = 0)
initialization: Initial guesses (§5.1 row 12): every tray inlet that is not a case inlet starts at the registered linear temperature profile (320 K at stage 1 to 400 K at stage N; a liquid inlet at the profile temperature of the stage above, a vapour inlet at that of the stage below), at IDAES's nominal flow of 1 mol/s (the property package's state-bound default), at the first inlet's composition and the registered pressure. Nothing of this project's results or the generator is used.

L1/L2: IDAES's own `TrayColumn.initialize()`. L3: IDAES's own unit initializers (`Tray`, `Condenser`, `Flash`, `Reboiler`) in `TrayColumn.initialize`'s order: the trays holding a case inlet first, then the end units from the nearest of them (propagate_state), then every other tray with its liquid inlet from the nearest initialized unit above and its vapour inlet from the nearest one below. Both are followed by one full model solve with IDAES's initializer solver (`get_solver()`, MUMPS; `TrayColumn.initialize` does not check its own last solve). An initializer exception is recorded and does not end the attempt; the final solve decides.

The initializers run at IDAES's default SmoothVLE eps (0.01 K, 5e-4 K). The registered eps_1 = eps_2 = 1e-8 K is set on every SmoothVLE state block after initialization and before the final solve, so the final solve and the accuracy rerun solve exactly the registered equations (rule 2b checks every block). Measured: at 1e-8 K IDAES's column initializer fails on the saturated inter-stage streams (docs/S03_BUILD_DECISIONS.md, WO-S03-2).

A specification equation (L2 b) on the end unit's own variables is a constraint of that unit and is active in its initializer. One on another stage's variables (a stage temperature) is deactivated during the initializers, with the end's native variable it replaces fixed at IDAES's own initial value for it (`Reboiler.boilup_ratio`: 0.5), and restored before the full solves.

sign_conversion: identity: IDAES's heat_duty (Condenser, Reboiler, Flash) is the heat into the control volume, W, so Q_condenser = condenser heat_duty and Q_reboiler = reboiler heat_duty, Q > 0 into the stage

case_definition.intermediate_duties_W: 0 on every stage that carries no end specification

realization.unit: composition of Tray, Condenser/Flash and Reboiler joined by Arcs

stage_map.rule: our j (S02 §1.1, condenser = 1 and reboiler = N when present); TrayColumn tray k = j - 1

feed_stages.enters_whole: yes: the whole stream enters this port; IDAES's Tray mixes its feed, liquid and vapour inlets into one equilibrium stage

condenser_realization: partial (S02) at L3: IDAES Flash; its vapour outlet is the distillate and its liquid outlet is joined by an Arc to stage 2's liquid inlet (all liquid refluxed); no liquid-distillate stream exists
reboiler_realization: kettle: IDAES Reboiler (equilibrium stage with duty; bottoms = liquid, vapor_reboil = vapour, returned to stage N-1)

movement.tolerance_value_used: the tool's own value (the script reads no other)

realization.reason: S02's partial condenser (vapour distillate, all liquid refluxed) is not IDAES's partial Condenser: that unit splits its liquid into reflux and a liquid distillate by reflux_split_fraction = RR/(1+RR), so its reflux_ratio is reflux over liquid distillate (not L_1/V_1, §5.1 row 9), and its liquid distillate flow is an Expression (1 - RR/(1+RR))*F_liq, not a variable: there is no tool variable to fix at 0 (L2 a), and the expression is 0 only at reflux_ratio = infinity. See structural_inspection
